subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Major Shipping Routes
description: A quick win: understand Major Shipping Routes.

hook.text: Three ocean routes carry most of the world's trade. Disrupt one and prices spike on every continent.

buildup.text: Asia–Europe, Transpacific, and Transatlantic are the three dominant global shipping lanes.

discovery.text: The Suez Canal and Panama Canal are critical chokepoints—shortcuts that save weeks of sailing.

twist.text: Geopolitical tension can close routes overnight. Houthi attacks in 2024 rerouted ships around Africa.

climax.text: Route disruptions add 10–20 days of transit and thousands in fuel. Supply chains feel it within weeks.

punchline.text: The world's trade flows through a few narrow lanes.

quiz.question: What are critical chokepoints in ocean shipping?
